provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: fixed Deployment baseline plus scoped host image/log observations

cases.task: Read the source image,pull policy,command and named port.
Compare unapproved-image broker rejection with ErrImageNeverPull from a scoped host fixture.
cases.expected: Two different failure phases are named; neither is described as an application crash.

cases.task: Record a bounded synthetic log excerpt with Pod UID,container name and restart count.
cases.expected: An evidence record ties the line to the exact observed process instance.

cases.task: Compare same Pod UID with restartCount1 against a new Pod UID with restartCount0.
cases.expected: First is a container restart; second is a different Pod instance.

cases.task: Run the allowed source under a qualified lease and state what its result does and does not observe.
cases.expected: Controller/Ready Pod identities and owned cleanup are observed; Deployment-only run has no Service-client proof.
